summary: A global luxury brand and Emirates Hills and Palm Jumeirah listings are strengths, but listing errors and hidden contact details appear to cost you leads.

findings.problem: Listings appear to offer only Email or 'Price on application' with no enquiry form visible, and no phone number or office address appears on the page.
findings.cost: A buyer who wants to ask a question has no easy channel.
findings.fix: Enquiry form, WhatsApp and visible office details.

findings.problem: 'Ultra-Luxurious | Custom-Built | Golf Course View' appears twice under Featured villas, and prices appear with a stray 'i' such as 'AED 33,683,187 i'.
findings.cost: Duplicate listings and stray characters look careless for a luxury brand.

findings.problem: The Rental Period filter appears to read 'Montly', a testimonial appears to say '7 days a a week', and its heading says Hanan Newair while the text says Newan.
findings.cost: Typos on a global brand site weaken trust.

findings.problem: Popular areas appear as '1 properties', two Paris listings share the same title, and only four testimonials appear with no dates.
findings.cost: Small content errors and thin proof lose high value buyers.
findings.fix: Correct grammar, unique titles and dated reviews.

redesign: Enquiry form, WhatsApp and visible office details.
Clean listing feed and proofread copy.
